## Summary

Describe the behavior and public API impact.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm verify`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` when browser or trust-boundary behavior changed
- [ ] Documentation and compile-time tests updated for public API changes

## Security impact

Describe changes to policy semantics, identity handling, resource loading, or error disclosure. Write `None` when the change has no security impact.
